text: Implemented UniquePointRegistry3 and CompiledAffinePatchTraversal3. Registry keys are exact Double coordinate bits from moving centre plus shared physical offset; no transformed or epsilon-based merging. It retains one integer gather map, first-owner map, sample-set multiplicities, primitive-byte estimate and measured setup nanoseconds. A duplicate fixture reduces 54 distinct-entry references and 135 draw-occurrence references to 36 interpolations while preserving gather/scatter sums; a 1e-10 coordinate difference remains 54 unique points. Traversal chooses by explicit arithmetic count between full unique-point transforms and centre plus 27 shared warped offsets. Duplicate centre/offset traversal matches independent patch values, world gradients and robust losses within 2e-14; no-duplicate unique traversal is bit-exact. Added a package-scoped canonical resample batch accepting world coordinates and applying the full inverse affine; pointwise parity is 2e-13. Evidence: resample JVM 12/12, JS 10/10, existing sparse hot path 88 B per 32768-sample batch at 40.193 MSamples/s in this run; Flashalign JVM 31/31, JS 31/31. Ownership 1145 unique/64 canonical; PRD/build graph 27/94; diff check clean. Timings are engineering evidence only, not MRI accuracy.
